_comment: Fixed place data and pairwise travel durations -- the World Map analog for this project. Durations are turn-count-agnostic (in_world_date days, not conversation turns) and sourced from docs/ELDARA_REFERENCE.md so this file never introduces geography the lore doc doesn't already establish. scripts/location_lookup.py reads this; scripts/validate_state.py cross-checks current_location/travel against it. Adding a new place or route here should be paired with a matching entry in ELDARA_REFERENCE.md §2.8/§2.3 -- this file is meant to mirror already-established lore, not originate it.

hollow_creek.name: Hollow Creek
hollow_creek.description: Palisaded frontier waypoint, a few hundred people. Chad's landing area. Roughly half a day's walk from where he arrived.

port_vessar.name: Port Vessar
port_vessar.description: Port settlement; reputation-economy culture around debt (§2.11).

silverhaven.name: Silverhaven
silverhaven.description: Elven settlement, reached by controlled forest paths.

routes._comment: Keys are '<location_id>|<location_id>' with ids sorted alphabetically, so each unordered pair is stored once. min_days/max_days are in in_world_date days. Sourced verbatim from ELDARA_REFERENCE.md §2.8's duration table.

highcrown|port_vessar.note: 10-14 days by road, 6-8 by water -- range spans both methods; narrate a specific method to pick the tighter sub-range on-screen.
